CAIS is hiring a full-time Marketing Data Analyst to join our Marketing team. This hybrid role blends marketing analytics, data modeling, and applied AI. You will turn campaign, event, and engagement data into clear answers on what drives advisor engagement and platform activity, and you will build the reporting and automation that gets those answers to Marketing, Sales, and leadership.
As we continue to expand our AI-first strategy, you will help explore and implement AI-driven workflows that improve efficiency, uncover opportunities, and accelerate how Marketing operates. We are looking for someone who can turn open-ended problems into structured solutions, explain what the data shows to colleagues who are not technical, and bridge technical and business perspectives.
You will report to Director, Digital Marketing and partner closely with the Data team, Sales, Product, and Operations. This is a hybrid position based in New York, NY, with an expectation of 3  days per week in the office.
Responsibilities
Insights and Reporting
Become an expert in alternative investments and CAIS data, and use what you learn to deliver insights that tie marketing activity to advisor engagement and platform outcomes
Build and maintain marketing performance reporting across email, campaigns, web, and events, covering engagement, attendance, pipeline influence, and post-event platform activity
Design and maintain dashboards and automated reports that give teams self-serve access to trends, patterns, and predictions
Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Product stakeholders to gather requirements, run analytics requests, and translate findings into clear recommendations
Data Modeling and Workflows
Develop scalable data models in Snowflake that unify marketing, CRM, and platform data into a single view of the advisor, with careful handling of attribution, deduplication, and timezones
Build and maintain automated data workflows that connect the data warehouse, marketing automation, CRM, and communication tools, including AI-enhanced enrichment and classification
Contribute to data governance and cataloging efforts, ensuring marketing data assets are documented, well-defined, and ready for AI use cases
Applied AI
Apply machine learning and AI techniques (such as segmentation, propensity and predictive modeling, natural language processing, and generative AI) to improve targeting, personalization, and decision-making
Experiment with emerging AI tools, deliver proofs of concept for stakeholders, and create reusable documentation and training that share AI-powered practices across the team
Qualifications
2 to 4 years of experience in marketing analytics, data analysis, or data science, preferably in technology or financial services
Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (Python preferred) for analytics and automation
Strong data modeling skills, including pre-aggregation to avoid join fan-out and consistent handling of timezones
Experience building dashboards and reports in a business intelligence tool (such as Tableau, Power BI, or Streamlit) or custom HTML reporting
Hands-on experience with marketing and CRM platform data (such as HubSpot or Salesforce) and an understanding of campaign, email, and event metrics
Working knowledge of core machine learning concepts (regression, classification, and clustering) and their practical application to marketing use cases
Exposure to AI use cases such as natural language processing, generative AI, or applications built on large language models
Ability to turn open-ended problems into structured solutions and communicate insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
Experience with cloud data platforms and transformation tools (Snowflake, AWS, dbt)
Experience with workflow automation or orchestration tools (such as n8n) and REST APIs
Experience with marketing technology platforms (such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Typeform, or Cvent) and reporting for marketing programs
Experience using large language models in production workflows, such as classification, enrichment, or content generation
Experience with Lucidchart, Visio, or similar diagramming tools
